::: {.callout-note}
## Students can't see this page yet

This page is only on the teacher site. To let students play at home, turn it on for them:

1. Open `course/play.qmd`.
2. In the labels at the top, change `audience: [teacher]` to `audience: [teacher, student]`.
3. Publish the student site again.

Then it's in the student site's sidebar as **Play at home**. High scores stay on each student's own phone or computer.
:::
:::

Choose a game and a unit. **Word Blitz** fits any screen, even a phone. The other games work best on a tablet or computer for now.
